questions.question: Why is data curation important before training an LLM?
choices: Garbage in, garbage out — poor data quality leads to poor model performance
It reduces the number of GPUs needed
It's required by the training framework
questions.explanation: Data quality directly impacts model quality. Cleaning training data removes noise, duplicates, and low-quality samples that would degrade model performance.

questions.question: When checking for duplicates, why should you trim whitespace first?
choices: Trimming makes strings shorter and faster to compare
'Hello' and '  Hello  ' are semantically the same but string-different
The test suite requires trimmed strings
questions.explanation: Without trimming, identical content with different whitespace would be treated as separate entries, defeating the purpose of deduplication.

questions.question: How should you handle punctuation-heavy lines in training data?
choices: Remove all lines containing any punctuation
Remove lines where punctuation exceeds 50% of characters
Keep all lines regardless of punctuation
questions.explanation: Some punctuation is valid (exclamation marks in sentences), but lines that are mostly punctuation are noise. Check the ratio, not just presence.
